axe:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished game UI visual direction mockup for an existing Japanese indie visual novel's AXE THROW mode-selection screen, 4:3 landscape, high resolution, straight-on screen image without device frame.
Image 1 is the actual current screen and must anchor all wording, three-mode structure, and the warm modern Japanese nighttime axe lounge world. Improve only the visual treatment: lavish tactile dark walnut, restrained brushed bronze/black steel, carved inset header, genuine premium bar sign craftsmanship, small warm pinlights, refined wood grain and gold inlays. Not medieval fantasy. Keep the reference lounge perspective and cages, target board at far right.
Composition: 8% top header, AXE THROW prominent upper left with small support copy. Preserve three equal large mode cards across the middle, each card distinct but harmonious, clear high-contrast cream Japanese text. Behind the heading a subtle pair of small decorative crossed axes worked into the panel's edge only, not a dominant weapon illustration. Add a handsome small target medallion above the first card, refined score tally engraving above the second, tiny crossed-axe medallion above the third, with decorative art confined to card tops. Keep full clear flat click surfaces, generous spacing, unambiguous hit areas. Material richness comes from borders, inlay, lighting and inset surfaces, never texture behind small text. These must be playable UI controls rather than a cinematic poster.
Exact visible copy: tiny top-left “水煙前線 -EN:CODE-”; top-right “NIGHT LOUNGE”; main title “AXE THROW”; subtitle “狙いを定めて、気持ちいい一投を。”
Three cards, left to right: “03 THROWS”, “3投で練習”, “練習をはじめる”; “10 THROWS”, “スコアアタック”, “記録に挑む”; “10 × 2 THROWS”, “ひよりと対戦”, “対戦をはじめる”.
Below cards: left label “練習を見守る相手” and two clean buttons “ひより”, “サメちゃん”; right label “ひより対戦の難易度” and three buttons “やさしい”, “ふつう”, “むずかしい”. Highlight ひより and ふつう with pale bronze fill.
Bottom utility row with separate clean controls: “本編へ”, “マキの無料投げレッスン”, “遊び方・得点ルール”.
No new modes, no scores or invented economics, no people or character portraits, no hookahs/smoking equipment, no logos other than text provided. Avoid clutter, illegible ornate type, excessive bevels, fake web browser chrome. Aim at an immediately believable implemented premium indie game menu, genuinely more luxurious than the reference without moving the functional hierarchy.
